title: Embedding external content and security/privacy considerations
learningObjectives: Use embedding external content and security/privacy considerations accessibly and safely.

understand.concept: iframe embeds another browsing context. Give it a descriptive title and grant only necessary sandbox and allow capabilities. Consider third-party tracking and referrer exposure.
understand.whyItMatters: Embedded content can run scripts and request capabilities, so permissions and privacy require deliberate limits.
understand.analogy: An iframe is like a window into another site, but it can run code and request capabilities.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy explains the idea only; browser behaviour depends on semantics, resource availability and format support.

explain.narrative: iframe embeds another browsing context. Give it a descriptive title and grant only necessary sandbox and allow capabilities. Consider third-party tracking and referrer exposure.

examples.code: <iframe src="https://example.com" title="Example website" sandbox="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></iframe>
examples.explanation: Inspect each attribute and test with a media file you own or are permitted to use.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser renders the element when its resource exists and the format is supported.

practise.guidedTask: Embed a trusted page with a title and restrictive sandbox. Explain any permission you add.
practise.independentTask: Build an accessible media section for a fictional learning page and explain your choices.
hints: Check the browser console and network panel if a resource fails.
Do not embed untrusted content without reviewing its origin and permissions.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Embedding external content and security/privacy considerations</title></head><body>
<iframe src="https://example.com" title="Example website" sandbox="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></iframe>
</body></html>

questions.explanation: Choose the semantic element or attribute designed for this purpose.

questions.prompt: Does every image need long descriptive alt text?
questions.explanation: Alt depends on purpose; decorative images use an empty alt attribute.
